job.title: Senior Mechanical Project Engineer
job.description:
Job Type: Full-Time
Industry: Power Generation / Energy

We are seeking a Senior Owner’s Engineer to provide technical leadership for gas turbine power generation projects from early-stage development through EPC execution, commissioning, and long-term asset optimization.

This is a highly technical, owner-side role for an experienced power-generation engineer with strong knowledge of open-cycle/simple-cycle gas turbines, balance-of-plant systems, equipment integration, EPC execution, and OEM management.

Key Responsibilities

Owner’s Engineering & Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the technical lead and subject matter expert for gas turbine generation projects.
  • Provide owner-side oversight of gas turbines and major auxiliary systems, including fuel gas, lubrication, hydraulics, inlet air, exhaust, cooling, emissions controls, fire protection, and black-start systems.
  • Ensure equipment and plant designs support long-term reliability, availability, maintainability, and operating economics.
  • Manage technical interfaces between the owner, EPC contractor, OEMs, equipment suppliers, and other project stakeholders.

Engineering & Project Development

  • Establish technical requirements, equipment specifications, performance requirements, and project boundary conditions.
  • Lead conceptual design, feasibility studies, technology evaluations, and project development activities.
  • Review and validate engineering deliverables including PFDs, P&IDs, equipment datasheets, specifications, heat and mass balances, and performance calculations.
  • Support selection and evaluation of simple-cycle, combined-cycle, CHP, and emerging power-generation configurations.

Technology & Efficiency

  • Evaluate technologies that improve plant efficiency, flexibility, output, and emissions performance.
  • Support assessments involving inlet air chilling, turbine power augmentation, thermal storage, intercooling, ORC, and other advanced technologies.
  • Lead technical evaluations of emissions-control technologies including SCR and CO/oxidation catalysts.
  • Support decarbonization initiatives, including carbon capture readiness and hydrogen blending.
  • Provide technical input into CAPEX, OPEX, lifecycle economics, and business-case development.

OEM, Procurement & EPC Management

  • Develop technical specifications, RFQs, bid requirements, and performance guarantees for major equipment and EPC contracts.
  • Lead technical evaluations of OEM and EPC proposals.
  • Manage technical deviations, change orders, warranties, and long-term service agreement interfaces.
  • Provide owner-side oversight throughout engineering, procurement, construction, installation, and commissioning.

Risk, Compliance & Permitting

  • Participate in HAZOP, HAZID, and other formal project risk reviews.
  • Identify and mitigate technical, operational, safety, and reliability risks.
  • Support air permitting, emissions modeling, and environmental compliance activities.
  • Ensure projects meet applicable EPA, state/local, environmental, safety, and industry requirements.

Commissioning & Operations

  • Participate in FATs, SATs, startup, commissioning, and performance testing.
  • Lead resolution of technical issues involving OEMs, EPC contractors, and equipment suppliers.
  • Provide ongoing engineering support to operating assets, including troubleshooting, outage planning, performance optimization, upgrades, and reliability improvements.
  • Evaluate retrofit and modernization opportunities to improve efficiency, emissions performance, and long-term asset value.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in gas turbine power generation, power project development, EPC execution, OEM engineering, or owner/operator environments.
  • Strong technical knowledge of open-cycle/simple-cycle gas turbines and balance-of-plant systems.
  • Experience with gas turbine auxiliaries, equipment integration, and mechanical/piping systems.
  • Experience reviewing PFDs, P&IDs, equipment specifications, datasheets, and thermal/performance documentation.
  • Experience with OEM and EPC contractor management.
  • Knowledge of emissions-control systems and air permitting requirements.
  • Experience supporting project development, procurement, commissioning, or plant operations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working for an IPP, power developer, utility, or owner/operator organization.
  • Simple-cycle and/or combined-cycle project execution experience.
  • Experience with HRSG/steam-cycle integration.
  • Gas turbine OEM experience with companies such as GE Vernova, Siemens Energy, Mitsubishi Power, Ansaldo, or similar.
  • Experience with air permitting and emissions compliance.
  • Knowledge of hydrogen blending, carbon capture, power augmentation, or other decarbonization technologies.
  • Field commissioning, startup, and performance testing experience.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred.

job.title: Financial Accountant
job.description:
About the Role



We are looking for a capable and hands-on Financial Accountant to join our team in a role that combines traditional finance responsibilities with ERP implementation and business systems support.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys more than just the numbers. Alongside supporting core accounting and finance functions, you will play an important role in the implementation and optimisation of our ERP environment, including Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) or a similar ERP platform.

You will work closely with Finance, Operations, IT and external implementation partners to help ensure that our new systems, processes and reporting are fit for purpose.

The ideal candidate will be a strong accountant who is also systems-minded, analytical, organised and comfortable working through problems and testing new processes.

Key Responsibilities



Finance & Accounting

  • Support day-to-day financial accounting and finance operations.
  • Assist with month-end and year-end close processes.
  • Prepare and review account reconciliations and financial reports.
  • Assist with general ledger, journals, accruals, prepayments and other accounting activities.
  • Support accounts payable and accounts receivable processes as required.
  • Assist with budgeting, forecasting and management reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls and reporting.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards and internal policies.



ERP Implementation & Systems

  • Support the implementation, configuration and optimisation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations or a similar ERP system.
  • Work with Finance and business stakeholders to understand current processes and future requirements.
  • Assist in translating finance requirements into practical system and process solutions.
  • Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including preparing test scenarios, executing test scripts and documenting results.
  • Identify, investigate and help resolve system issues, data issues and process gaps.
  • Validate financial transactions, workflows, reporting and integrations within the ERP.
  • Assist with data migration activities, including data validation and reconciliation.
  • Review and document business processes and system procedures.
  • Work with implementation partners, consultants and internal stakeholders to track issues through to resolution.
  • Support system cutover, go-live and post-implementation activities.
  • Help develop user guides, process documentation and training materials.
  • Act as a key link between the Finance team and ERP/IT stakeholders.



About You

We are looking for someone who combines strong accounting fundamentals with an interest in technology and business systems.

You will ideally have:

  • Relevant accounting qualifications or significant accounting experience.
  • Experience working in a Financial Accountant or similar finance role.
  • Strong understanding of general ledger, month-end close, reconciliations and financial reporting.
  • Experience with an ERP system such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dynamics AX, SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Pronto, TechnologyOne or a similar platform.
  • An understanding of ERP implementation, system upgrades or process improvement would be highly desirable.
  • Experience with UAT, system testing, requirements gathering or data validation would be advantageous.
  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with financial data.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to problem solving.
  • The ability to understand both finance processes and how those processes translate into an ERP system.
  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to work with Finance, IT, Operations and external consultants.
  • A proactive attitude and willingness to get involved and solve problems rather than simply identify them.



What We Offer

  • A broad and varied role across Finance and business systems.
  • The opportunity to play a key role in an ERP transformation.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Dynamics 365 and modern finance technology.
  • The opportunity to work closely with senior Finance, Operations and IT stakeholders.
  • A role with genuine scope to improve processes and ways of working.
  • Support and development as you build your ERP and systems expertise.

job.title: Sr Manufacturing Engineer
job.description:
Manufacturing Engineer

Location: Draper, UT

Schedule: Standard

Contract Duration: 12 Months

Maximum Pay Rate: $47-52/hr.



Position Overview

The Manufacturing Engineer applies engineering theory and principles to solve problems related to industrial layout, manufacturing processes, production, and operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience with manufacturing processes, engineering drawings, blueprints, production standards, quality assurance, and process improvement. The role requires the ability to analyze production data, evaluate workflows, and collaborate with management and engineering teams to improve efficiency, quality, and reliability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct time, motion, method, and speed studies related to maintenance, production, and other operations to establish standard production rates and improve operational efficiency.
  • Interpret engineering drawings, schematic diagrams, formulas, blueprints, and technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with management and engineering personnel to establish and maintain quality and reliability standards.
  • Review worker logs, product processing sheets, specification sheets, and other production records to ensure compliance with quality assurance requirements.
  • Assist in planning and assigning work based on worker performance, machine capacity, production schedules, and anticipated delays.
  • Develop charts, graphs, and diagrams to illustrate:
    • Workflow and routing
    • Manufacturing floor layouts
    • Material handling processes
    • Machine utilization
  • Observe employees operating manufacturing equipment to verify that equipment is being operated and maintained in accordance with quality and safety standards.
  • Conduct time and motion observations using appropriate timing devices to determine task completion times and evaluate fatigue factors.
  • Analyze production and operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and deviations from established standards.
  • Prepare technical reports and documentation to validate existing standards or identify areas requiring improvement.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong creativity, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to perform common engineering calculations and computations.
  • Ability to create sketches and engineering drawings.
  • Proficiency in reading and interpreting:
    • Blueprints
    • Technical drawings
    • Schematics
    • Computer-generated reports
  • Experience with computer applications and engineering-related software, including Computer-Aided Design (CAD).

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering required.
  • 5–7 years of relevant manufacturing engineering experience required.

job.title: Investment Analyst
job.description:
Investment Analyst



Day Rate Contract | Sydney | 6 months



· We are partnering with a leading Australian financial services organisation looking for an experienced Investment Analyst to join its Investments function.

· This is not a traditional Business Analyst or pure Data Analyst position. The team is looking for an investment generalist who can work across investment analysis, data, reporting and business processes, moving between different areas depending on the needs of the investment team.



Role

· Working closely with stakeholders across Investments, Data and Technology, you will support a broad range of investment and business process initiatives.



Key responsibilities

· Work across a range of initiatives within the Investments function, providing analytical, data and process support.

· Analyse investment and portfolio data to support investment teams and business decision-making.

· Work with fund structures, investment products, portfolios and investment data across multiple asset classes.

· Use SQL to interrogate, validate and analyse investment data.

· Work with investment and market data platforms including FactSet.

· Support ESG / responsible investment data, reporting and related initiatives.

· Undertake current-state and future-state process mapping across investment processes.

· Identify data issues, process inefficiencies and opportunities to improve controls, reporting and ways of working.

· Gather and translate business requirements while taking a broader approach than a traditional BA.

· Facilitate workshops and work closely with Investment, Data, Technology and Operations stakeholders.

· Support data quality, governance, reporting and continuous improvement initiatives.



Skillset

· The key to this role is breadth. You may currently be an Investment Analyst, Investment Data Analyst, Investment BA or Business Process Analyst, but you will be comfortable working outside the traditional boundaries of your job title.



Ideally, you will bring:

· Strong investment domain knowledge, ideally from superannuation, asset management or investment management.

· Good understanding of fund structures and investment portfolios.

· Experience with FactSet or similar investment/market data platforms.

· Exposure to ESG / responsible investment data and reporting.

· Hands-on SQL capability and confidence working with investment data.

· Experience across business process analysis, process mapping and process improvement.

· Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn complex investment data into practical insights.

· Ability to operate across Investments, Data and Business Analysis rather than specialising solely in one area.

· Strong stakeholder management skills, particularly with investment professionals.

· A pragmatic, adaptable approach and willingness to work across a variety of initiatives.



The Opportunity

· This role would suit a genuine Investment Generalist – someone who understands investments but also has the data and business process capability to solve a variety of problems.

· You don't need to be the deepest specialist in every area. The key is being able to understand an investment problem, interrogate the underlying data, map the associated processes and work with stakeholders to determine the best way forward.

CAPA Management & Leadership

    • Templates
    • Work instructions

  • Perform gap assessments against applicable quality and regulatory requirements, including:

  • Ensure CAPA processes remain aligned with regulatory and quality system expectations.

Documentation & Audit Readiness

  • Ensure documentation compliance across the CAPA subsystem.
  • Maintain accurate and complete CAPA records with strong:
    • Record integrity
    • Traceability
    • Documentation practices
  • Ensure both closed and active CAPA records remain audit-ready.
  • Identify documentation gaps and drive appropriate corrective actions.

Risk Management & Systemic Issue Assessment

  • Apply risk-based decision-making when evaluating systemic nonconformities.
  • Assess potential impacts to:
    • Quality Management System

    • Processes
    • Regulatory compliance
  • Determine the appropriate scope and depth of corrective actions based on risk and potential impact.

Quality System Integration

  • Connect CAPA outcomes with other quality system processes, including:
    • Customer complaints
    • Nonconformances (NCs)
    • Internal and external audit findings
    • Risk management
    • Management Review
  • Identify relationships between quality events and systemic issues.

Audit & Inspection Support – Preferred

job.title: GSE Build Technician II
job.description:
GSE Build Technician II

Hydrogen Group is hiring on behalf of a confidential client, a leading aerospace and advanced manufacturing organization supporting complex vehicle production, testing, and launch operations.

Position Overview

We are seeking a GSE Build Technician II to support the fabrication, installation, maintenance, testing, and troubleshooting of ground support equipment (GSE) used across rocket production, test, and launch environments.

This is a hands-on Level II technician position requiring the ability to independently execute assigned work with limited supervision. The role will work closely with Engineering, Test Operations, Launch Operations, Quality, EH&S, and other technical teams to construct and maintain mechanical systems, fluid systems, test infrastructure, launch equipment, and related facility systems.

The work may involve stainless-steel tubing and piping, valves, regulators, instrumentation, manifolds, structural components, hydraulic and pneumatic equipment, high-pressure gas and cryogenic systems, pumps, and other mechanical GSE.

Technicians at this level are expected to take ownership of assigned scopes—from reviewing technical documentation and gathering the appropriate tools and materials through fabrication, installation, troubleshooting, testing, and final documentation. The ability to identify and address routine issues independently, while knowing when to involve Engineering, Quality, EH&S, or leadership, is essential.

This position is based at a rocket production facility in Briggs, Texas, north of Cedar Park.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently execute GSE fabrication, installation, maintenance, repair, troubleshooting, modification, and upgrade activities across production, test, launch, and facility environments.
  • Build mechanical and fluid assemblies using released engineering drawings and technical documentation, including tubing, piping, valves, regulators, gauges, instrumentation, manifolds, panels, structural supports, and related components.
  • Prepare, measure, bend, route, fit, and install stainless-steel tubing and piping using approved fabrication practices.
  • Assemble and install a variety of mechanical and fluid-system interfaces, including compression fittings, NPT, AN/MS-style connections, flanges, and other approved connection types.
  • Select and install appropriate fittings, seals, fasteners, and related hardware based on system requirements.
  • Perform torque and controlled-fastener installation using calibrated equipment while maintaining proper component orientation, accessibility, cleanliness, support, and overall workmanship.
  • Interpret mechanical drawings, fabrication and assembly documentation, schematics, P&IDs, work instructions, and other technical information to execute assigned work and verify installed configurations.
  • Identify discrepancies between field conditions and engineering requirements and communicate issues through the appropriate channels.
  • Prepare for upcoming work by determining required tooling, materials, hardware, consumables, access equipment, and other resources.
  • Coordinate concurrent activities and plan work efficiently to reduce equipment or operational downtime.
  • Conduct visual and dimensional inspections, troubleshooting, leak checks, flushing, cleaning, commissioning, system verification, and other qualified testing activities.
  • Assist with high-pressure gas, cryogenic, hydraulic, pneumatic, pump, valve, and other stored-energy systems, including hydrostatic and pneumatic testing when properly trained and authorized.
  • Adhere to established requirements for pressure systems, exclusion zones, barricades, stored energy, lockout/tagout (LOTO), FOD, ESD, PPE, contamination control, cleanliness, and other applicable safety and quality procedures.
  • Escalate technical, safety, quality, or operational concerns to Engineering, Quality, EH&S, or leadership when appropriate.
  • Provide field feedback regarding constructability, maintainability, accessibility, and system operability.
  • Support construction, modification, commissioning, verification, maintenance, and upgrade work at test stands and launch facilities.
  • Participate in rigging, crane, forklift, aerial-lift, and other material-handling activities when appropriately trained and qualified.
  • Maintain clean, organized, test-ready workspaces and complete required inspections of equipment and work areas.
  • Record completed work, installation details, photographs, discrepancies, constraints, and open actions within JIRA or other designated electronic work-management platforms.
  • Work collaboratively with other technicians and functional groups and provide hands-on guidance and informal mentorship to Level I technicians.
  • Contribute ideas and participate in continuous improvement efforts related to tooling, fabrication techniques, work sequencing, organization, and execution processes.
  • Provide hands-on support for Test and Launch activities as directed by the applicable operations or engineering teams.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • At least 3 years of professional hands-on experience in mechanical fabrication, maintenance, aerospace, aviation, military, industrial construction, process piping, or a related technical discipline.
  • Proven ability to independently perform mechanical fabrication, assembly, installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting work.
  • Proficiency with hand tools, power tools, calibrated/torque tools, and basic precision measurement equipment.
  • Ability to interpret and work from mechanical drawings, fabrication or assembly drawings, schematics, P&IDs, work instructions, and similar technical documentation.
  • Practical experience with tubing, piping, valves, fittings, hydraulic or pneumatic equipment, process equipment, or comparable mechanical fluid systems.
  • Understanding of workmanship standards, configuration control, cleanliness, safety practices, and technical documentation requirements.
  • Ability to organize and execute routine assignments without constant oversight, recognize areas of technical uncertainty, and obtain clarification rather than making unapproved changes.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple technical and operational teams.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities while maintaining a strong focus on safety and quality.
  • Ability to safely lift a minimum of 30 pounds, remain standing for extended periods, and work in industrial, production, test-stand, launch-site, and outdoor environments.
  • Ability and willingness to travel to project locations as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate degree in engineering technology, mechanical technology, aviation maintenance, welding, industrial technology, or a related technical field.
  • A&P license, relevant trade certification, or advanced military technical training.
  • Previous experience in aerospace GSE, launch operations, rocket testing, aviation maintenance, military maintenance, oil and gas, semiconductor/high-purity environments, chemical or process facilities, power generation, shipyards, or industrial mechanical construction.
  • Hands-on experience fabricating stainless-steel tubing, including manual tube bending and tube preparation.
  • Experience working with Swagelok or comparable compression-fitting systems.
  • Familiarity with NPT, AN, MS, flange, Grayloc, or similar fluid-system connections and welded tubing/piping assemblies.
  • Experience working with high-pressure gas, cryogenic, hydraulic, pneumatic, oxygen-clean/high-purity systems, pressure testing, hydrostatic proof testing, pneumatic leak testing, or system commissioning.
  • Exposure to orbital tube welding processes or associated preparation requirements.
  • Experience operating or working around cranes, rigging equipment, forklifts, telehandlers, boom lifts, or similar material-handling equipment.
  • Experience managing controlled hazardous energy, LOTO, pressurized systems, and other stored-energy hazards.
  • Familiarity with ASME B31.3 or comparable industrial piping standards.
  • Experience using JIRA, electronic work-order platforms, MES, SAP, Maximo, Confluence, Microsoft Office, or similar systems.
  • Experience creating photographic installation records or other documentation used for configuration control.

Android (primary depth)

Backend and API

Banking-specific mobile concerns

  • Feature flags, remote config, phased/staged rollout, kill switches
  • Offline behaviour, caching and state management, and what happens at the edges

Essential non-technical skills

  • Structured interviewing - runs a technical interview that yields specifics rather than a tour of opinions, and captures it in a form the team can use
  • Rigorous note-taking and traceability - findings can be traced back to a source; distinguishes what was observed in code from what someone said
  • Collaborative, non-territorial — will be reviewing other engineers' work in front of them; needs to do it without triggering defensiveness
  • Self-directed under time pressure — 8 weeks means little supervision and no ramp-up period
  • Fluent professional English, spoken and written


Nice to have

  • Kotlin Multiplatform, React Native, or hybrid/webview integration experience
  • Diagramming from code: Structurizr, PlantUML, Mermaid, dependency-graph tooling

job.description:
Robotics Engineer – NACHI / FANUC




LOCATION: Toledo, OH → Normal, IL - both onsite

SCHEDULE: 60 hours/week, 12-hour shifts; rotating AM/PM

DURATION: 3-month initial contract

PAY: 51-56 USD per hour

IMPORTANT: Candidates will spend approximately 2–3 months in Toledo, OH before transitioning to Normal, IL. This is an onsite position at both locations.



Job Responsibilities:

In this role, you will be responsible for the programming, integration, commissioning, and optimization of robotic arc welding systems within an automotive Bodyshop environment. You will work primarily with FANUC and NACHI robotic platforms to support MIG welding applications and ensure production-ready, repeatable processes.

Key responsibilities include:

· Programming and integrating NACHI and FANUC robots for automotive body-in-white (BIW) applications.

· Developing and optimizing complex MIG welding paths and robotic trajectories.

· Configuring and fine-tuning welding parameters to achieve consistent weld quality and minimize defects.

· Supporting robotic system integration from initial programming and commissioning through production startup.

· Optimizing robotic welding processes to reduce spatter, thermal distortion, and cycle times.

· Establishing and following robotic programming standards based on process requirements and application types.

· Supporting the structural and geometric integrity of BIW sub-assemblies through accurate and repeatable robotic welding processes.

· Troubleshooting robot, welding, hardware, software, and process-related issues in a high-volume automotive production environment.

Essential Duties and Job Functions:

· Program and refine complex MIG welding trajectories on NACHI robots.

· Optimize torch positioning, including work and travel angles and electrode stick-out.

· Configure welding parameter schedules directly on robotic controllers.

· Troubleshoot and eliminate welding defects including porosity, lack of fusion, undercut, and excessive burn-through.

· Develop and maintain automatic Tool Center Point (TCP) check routines.

· Perform TCP maintenance and calibration following consumable changes, including contact tips, nozzles, and goosenecks.

· Maintain accurate and documented backup and version-control procedures for robot controllers.

· Create and maintain periodic image backups of robotic controller systems.

· Program and configure FANUC robots using ArcTool, including weld schedules, torch control, and tool coordinate systems.

· Program and configure NACHI FD/AX series controllers for MIG/arc welding applications.

· Configure power-source interfaces and synchronize robot travel speed with wire feed rates.

· Integrate and maintain welding peripherals, including torch cleaning stations, reamers, wire cutters, neck aligners, and automated TCP calibration equipment.

· Configure communication interfaces including Digital/Analog, DeviceNet, and EtherNet/IP.

· Integrate robotic systems with welding power sources including Fronius TPS/i, Lincoln Electric, and Miller equipment.

· Implement and maintain robot safety systems, including FANUC Dual Check Safety (DCS) and NACHI RMU (Robot Monitoring Unit).

· Support robotic commissioning, startup, and production readiness activities.

· Perform rapid root-cause analysis and troubleshooting during high-volume automotive production.

· Collaborate with PLC programmers, mechanical designers, weld quality inspectors, maintenance technicians, and other engineering teams.

Knowledge & Skills:

· Advanced knowledge of FANUC robot programming and ArcTool.

· Strong hands-on experience programming and integrating NACHI robots.

· Strong understanding of NACHI FD/AX series controllers and arc applications.

· Deep knowledge of MIG/MAG welding processes and robotic welding applications.

· Strong understanding of welding parameters, including voltage, amperage, wire feed speed, and shielding gas flow.

· Knowledge of welding transfer modes, including short-circuit, globular, spray, and pulsed arc.

· Experience integrating robotic welding systems with industrial power sources.

· Knowledge of Fronius, Lincoln Electric, and/or Miller welding systems.

· Experience with Digital/Analog, DeviceNet, and EtherNet/IP communication interfaces.

· Experience integrating welding peripherals and automated TCP calibration systems.

· Knowledge of FANUC DCS and NACHI RMU safety systems.

· Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.

· Ability to work effectively in a high-pressure, high-volume automotive production environment.

· Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.

· Ability to work with PLC programmers, mechanical engineers/designers, weld quality teams, and maintenance personnel.

· Professional working proficiency in English.

· Ability to work extended hours and rotating 12-hour shifts as required.

Education & Experience:

· Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Automation, Welding, Electromechanical Engineering, or a related field.

· Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience programming and integrating FANUC and NACHI robots.

· Minimum of 2 years of experience with MIG welding applications.

· Experience working with robotic welding systems in an automotive BIW/Bodyshop environment.

· Demonstrated experience integrating robotic systems from initial programming through commissioning and production startup.

· Experience with FANUC ArcTool programming is required.

· Experience with NACHI robotic programming and integration is required.

· Experience with welding power-source integration and robotic peripherals is highly desirable.

· Experience with robot safety systems, including FANUC DCS and NACHI RMU, is preferred.

· Experience troubleshooting robotic welding systems in a high-volume manufacturing environment is highly desirable.

job.description:

Location: Juno Beach, FL – Hybrid
Contract: 12 Months
Pay Rate: Up to $52.96 per hour

We are seeking an experienced Senior BESS Engineer to support a Utility Scale Energy Storage team, providing technical expertise across battery energy storage system (BESS) sizing, optimization, battery technology and power conversion systems (PCS).

This position will serve as a technical Subject Matter Expert supporting utility-scale energy storage projects and the evaluation of existing and emerging storage technologies.

The successful candidate will combine strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on BESS sizing experience and an innovative approach to engineering tools, automation, data analytics and emerging technologies.

BESS Sizing & Optimization

  • Provide technical leadership for utility-scale BESS sizing methodologies, assumptions, optimization and project-specific sizing decisions.

  • Develop and optimize end-to-end BESS sizing from the point of interconnection through GSU/substation, PCS/inverters, DC systems and battery equipment.

  • Account for system losses, battery degradation, augmentation and overbuild strategies, temperature effects, operating constraints and contractual requirements.

  • Ensure sizing solutions align with power purchase agreements and project-specific technical requirements.

  • Develop, maintain and continuously improve BESS sizing methodologies, calculators, assumptions and technical guidance.

  • Maintain accurate records of sizing inputs, assumptions, technical decisions and results throughout project development and execution.

  • Review project-specific sizing results and identify optimization opportunities, risks and potential improvements.

  • Provide sizing recommendations to Engineering, Development, Supply Chain and project teams.

  • Maintain sizing tools and equipment databases to incorporate current BESS and PCS ratings and technical characteristics.

Battery & Energy Storage Technology Evaluation

  • Evaluate existing and emerging battery technologies for utility-scale applications.

  • Perform technical assessments covering degradation, efficiency, available energy, reliability, state of charge (SOC) and state of health (SOH).

  • Evaluate battery performance from cell and module level through complete system applications.

  • Assess emerging and alternative energy storage technologies for new use cases and regional market requirements.

  • Evaluate technologies based on technical maturity, performance, safety, scalability, supply chain readiness and commercial viability.

  • Develop preliminary system sizing and CAPEX estimates for alternative energy storage technologies.

  • Support technology selection, business-case development, pilot projects and commercial deployment decisions.

  • Analyze vendor RFP and RFI information to track technology developments, product roadmaps, performance and commercial readiness.

  • Summarize technical findings and provide recommendations to engineering and management teams.

Digital Engineering, Automation & AI

  • Develop and improve engineering tools used for BESS sizing, technical evaluations and battery performance forecasting.

  • Automate repetitive engineering calculations and workflows where appropriate.

  • Apply data analytics and software-based tools to improve engineering productivity, consistency and decision-making.

  • Utilize tools such as Excel/VBA, Python, Power BI, low-code platforms and AI-assisted engineering applications where appropriate.

  • Identify practical applications for emerging technologies and AI within energy storage engineering.

  • Partner with software development and technical teams to translate engineering methodologies into scalable digital tools and automated workflows.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Demonstrated experience with utility-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS).

  • Strong expertise in BESS sizing and optimization, including AC/DC sizing, system losses, degradation, augmentation/overbuild strategies, thermal impacts and project-specific operating requirements.

  • Knowledge of battery technologies and utility-scale energy storage system architecture.

  • Experience evaluating battery and/or PCS technologies.

  • Strong analytical and engineering problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent project management, communication and organizational capabilities.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical findings and recommendations across engineering and business teams.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with emerging or alternative storage technologies such as flow batteries, multi-day energy storage, sodium-ion batteries, fuel-cell-like technologies or supercapacitors.

  • Knowledge of power electronics, including PCS/inverters, IGBT and SiC technologies.

  • Experience working with major or emerging battery and PCS suppliers.

  • Experience applying Python, Excel/VBA, Power BI, automation, AI or advanced data analytics to engineering applications.

  • Experience developing engineering calculation, sizing or performance-prediction tools.

  • Understanding of utility-scale energy storage commercial and project requirements.

  • Strong interest in emerging battery technologies and continuously improving existing engineering processes.

Some travel to battery manufacturing facilities may be required to support technology assessments.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm

Pay Rate: $33.50 to $37.50 per hour




Position Summary

Our client is a Southern California electric utility operating substation infrastructure from 4kV through 500kV, subject to North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) compliance requirements. This role sits within the Substation Projects group and carries substation projects from pre-engineering through design delivery. Day to day, that means leading job walks with Construction, Operations, Maintenance, Telecomm and Field Engineering to build the scope of work, writing and issuing design specification documents, developing and updating AutoCAD drawings, and placing orders for long-lead major equipment against material want dates. The role also provides technical direction to the in-house design team and manages the Prime engineering contractor on design quality, milestone dates and cost, including reviewing design cost proposals and approving purchase orders through Ariba. Alongside planned project work, the engineer supports field personnel on emergent issues, service reliability and NERC reporting, and contributes to mentoring newer engineers in the group. The ideal background blends substation engineering and design with project management experience and a strong technical engineering foundation.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Develops preliminary scope of work, schedules and conducts pre-engineering job walk meetings with stakeholders (Construction, Maintenance, Operations, IT, Telecomm, Field Engineering, Test, etc.)
  • Creates, approves and publishes pre-engineering job walk meeting minutes and design specification documents
  • Visits substations and participates in field job walks, typically once or twice per month, with frequency varying according to project workload and field support needs
  • Orders major equipment in a timely manner to meet material want dates
  • Manages various in-house design projects by providing technical engineering and design support to the design team, as well as providing training and direction
  • Manages the Prime engineering contractor, working with the contractor to ensure consistency and high quality of design, delivery milestone dates, and cost
  • Reviews, evaluates and approves engineering contractor design cost proposals on direct award and/or competitive bidding projects
  • Participates in the mentoring and training of new engineers as required to help develop the technical expertise of the Substation Projects group
  • Reviews and approves Purchase Order Requests, change orders and service sheets through the Ariba system
  • Provides technical support to field personnel and other internal/external stakeholders and project related team members as required
  • Provides engineering support for ongoing operational needs to support service reliability and meet other related compliance requirements, such as emergent projects and/or stakeholder requests and emergencies, as well as NERC compliance and reporting
  • Creates and maintains a safety conscious work environment by leading and influencing others to follow the client's safety protocols and safe work practices

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, or a Bachelor's degree in a scientific, technical or math field. A BSc in Electrical Engineering with a Power Engineering focus is preferred given the technical nature of the work
  • Two (2) or more years of experience in substation engineering and design. Candidates with five (5) or more years of applicable engineering experience are encouraged to apply, and additional experience is viewed positively. This is not an entry-level position
  • Project management experience alongside a strong technical engineering background
  • Substation engineering and design experience is strongly preferred. Candidates without direct substation exposure will also be considered where they bring strong electrical design experience and can be trained on substation design work, including those from oil and gas, facilities, industrial electrical design and other electrical engineering environments
  • Professional Engineer (P.E.) licence in the State of California is preferred but not required
  • Candidates must be local to the region they support. Out-of-state candidates will only be considered where relocation is already complete and aligns with onboarding timelines

Knowledge/Skills

  • AutoCAD design experience developing and updating AutoCAD drawings
  • Electrical design fundamentals including conduit design, grounding design, one-line diagrams, schematic diagrams and general power engineering concepts
  • General knowledge and experience with guides, standards, codes, and methods to perform complex assignments
  • Working knowledge of AutoCAD, Bluebeam, Design Manager, Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  • Highly organised, with excellent verbal and written communication skills, experience conducting field meetings discussing scope of work, and excellent note taking skills
  • Experience with 3D design and modelling tools is a plus but not required, as training can be provided
  • General knowledge and experience with regulations, guides, standards, codes, methods, and practices necessary to perform complex assignments for a specific discipline, various installations, or services (desired)
  • Power utility substation experience, 4kV through 500kV (desired)

job.title: Senior R&D Technician (Irvine, CA)
job.description:
Location: Irvine, CA (Onsite)

Schedule: Standard

Duration: 6-Month Contract (W2)

Pay Rate: $29.50 - $33.50/hr





Position Summary




Our client is a medical device manufacturer, and this six-month contract supports its R&D Tech QA Engineering team. The Senior Technician supports R&D and QA Engineering by setting up and executing feasibility studies, experiments, and tests; creating and following established protocols; collecting and analyzing results; making observations and recommendations; and developing documentation for Engineering review. The role operates a variety of laboratory and test equipment to assess product, component, and process performance and works closely with engineers and technicians in a highly collaborative project environment. The primary focus is hands-on mechanical laboratory testing and execution rather than a purely manufacturing or prototype-building role. Candidates may be placed across appropriate testing activities based on experience, demonstrated capability, and the needs of the project team.





Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Consult and collaborate with Engineers, Technicians, and Assemblers to execute experiments, testing activities, investigations, and/or production-related support work.
  • Perform hands-on mechanical testing, including work such as tensile testing, leak testing, and other laboratory or design-verification-related test methods.
  • Set up, operate, and troubleshoot laboratory, inspection, and mechanical test equipment; document results accurately and escalate unexpected findings as appropriate.
  • Review documentation and take appropriate action to ensure information is accurately cataloged and carried through equipment validation and qualification activities, including transfer to appropriate systems or records such as ECRs, SOPs, drawings, and tooling documentation for Engineering approval.
  • Utilize applicable manufacturing and documentation systems (e.g., JDE, QMS, PLM) to update records and maintain accurate documentation.
  • Support the development of training and documentation materials in collaboration with Engineering and identify opportunities for process, equipment, or workflow improvement.
  • Apply practical knowledge of testing and manufacturing processes to recommend improvements, including basic equipment, tool, or fixture modifications for Engineering review.
  • May lead or independently coordinate smaller workstreams related to equipment validation, equipment investigations, testing, product disposition support, and rework support.
  • Provide coaching, guidance, or technical support to less-experienced technicians when appropriate.
  • Work fully onsite in an R&D laboratory that supports R&D, ISO/lab, and design-verification-related testing activities; this is not a remote, hybrid, or cleanroom position.
  • Perform hands-on laboratory, mechanical, and testing work throughout the scheduled workday, including repetitive push/pull activity on some testing equipment and applying approximately 5-25 pounds of force.





Education/Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • A bachelor's degree, including Mechanical Engineering, is acceptable but is not required. A master's degree is not required, and advanced education alone is not a substitute for hands-on technical capability.
  • Experience level may range broadly from developing Technician-level candidates to more experienced Senior Technician candidates; approximately 1-5+ years may be considered depending on the depth and relevance of hands-on testing experience.
  • Strong hands-on Technician-level candidates may be considered, even without a traditional senior-level profile, when their hands-on capability and team fit are strong.
  • Practical capability, mechanical aptitude, reliability, communication, and collaboration are more important than a rigid years-of-experience threshold.
  • A mechanical background is strongly preferred. Candidates whose experience is primarily chemical or biological without relevant mechanical testing experience are not the target profile.
  • Laboratory testing, mechanical testing, medical device inspection, QA/QC, manufacturing test, or closely related technical experience is preferred.
  • Manufacturing or prototype-building experience may be considered when paired with strong testing aptitude and the ability to learn quickly.





Knowledge/Skills

  • Strong hands-on mechanical and technical aptitude and demonstrated experience with laboratory testing, inspection, or mechanical test execution; comfortable working directly with test equipment and physical components.
  • Experience with tensile testing, leak testing, or comparable mechanical test methods is strongly preferred. Experience with product development, fixture development, or prototype building is a plus, but testing capability is the higher priority.
  • Ability to interpret and follow test procedures, protocols, work instructions, and technical documentation.
  • Ability to learn client-specific equipment, test methods, processes, and Environmental Health and Safety and Quality guidelines; candidates do not need to be fully plug-and-play on day one. The team is open to training a candidate with the right technical foundation, attitude, and learning agility.
  • Basic understanding of medical device inspection, quality, laboratory testing, or design-verification concepts, and knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices and Good Documentation Practices, preferred.
  • Strict attention to detail and commitment to accurate, traceable documentation required.
  • Excellent computer skills, including MS Office Suite; ERP/MRP or similar systems experience preferred.
  • Clear, professional communication and strong collaboration skills, with a positive working style and the ability to work effectively with engineers, technicians, and managers in a project team.
  • Willingness to take technical direction and feedback, and ability to give feedback in a professional, direct, and tactful manner.
  • Flexibility to support different types of laboratory and testing work, working with appropriate independence while staying responsive to project-team priorities.

job.description:
Senior Transmission & Distribution Line Engineer

Location: Pomona, CA – Hybrid, 2 days per week onsite
Contract: 12 Months
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
Pay Rate: $64.47 per hour

We are seeking an experienced Senior Transmission & Distribution Line Engineer to support electric utility overhead line design and engineering projects.

This role will perform transmission and distribution line design and analysis using industry-standard engineering tools including PLS-CADD and PLS-Pole, develop engineering packages for overhead line and pole/foundation projects, and provide technical support throughout design and construction.

A Professional Engineer (PE) license is not required for this position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform transmission and distribution line design and analysis using PLS-CADD, PLS-Pole, SPIDAcalc and related engineering software.

  • Develop and review engineering packages for overhead transmission and distribution line projects.

  • Perform engineering analysis associated with pole and foundation designs.

  • Complete engineering calculations and technical reviews to support utility line design.

  • Ensure designs comply with GO95, NESC, ASCE and applicable utility engineering standards.

  • Independently perform engineering design work and technical reviews.

  • Identify and resolve technical and design-related issues.

  • Provide technical support to construction and field personnel.

  • Participate in field visits when required to support engineering and construction activities.

  • Collaborate with project teams and other engineering disciplines.

  • Provide technical guidance and engineering support throughout project execution.

  • Support the continuous improvement of engineering standards, procedures and design practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

  • 3+ years of electric utility transmission and/or distribution line design experience.

  • Experience using PLS-CADD and/or PLS-Pole.

  • Knowledge of GO95, NESC and applicable utility design standards.

  • Strong analytical and engineering problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to independently perform engineering design work and technical reviews.

Preferred Experience

  • SPIDAcalc experience.

  • PLS-Caisson experience.

  • California electric utility experience.

  • Experience with pole and foundation design.

  • Experience applying ASCE standards to utility engineering projects.

Key Technical Skills

The strongest candidates will combine electric utility transmission or distribution line design experience with hands-on knowledge of PLS-CADD or PLS-Pole and familiarity with overhead line design standards.

Experience with California utility requirements, GO95, SPIDAcalc, PLS-Caisson and pole/foundation engineering would be particularly valuable.

PE license is not required.

We are seeking a motivated Junior Power Systems Database Modeler to support computer-based modeling activities within the energy and utilities sector.

job.description:
Safety QA/QC Analyst

Location: Chino, CA
Contract: 18 Months
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
Pay Rate: $56.68 per hour

We are seeking a detail-oriented Safety QA/QC Analyst to support Safety Management System quality assurance and quality control activities.

This position will focus on tracking, validating and analyzing program data associated with field verification activities, conformance checks, corrective actions and implementation milestones. The analyst will work across multiple Operating Units and workstreams, helping identify trends, gaps and follow-up requirements while maintaining accurate and audit-ready documentation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support Safety Management System QA/QC activities across multiple Operating Units and workstreams.

  • Track, validate and maintain program data related to field verification activities, conformance checks, corrective actions and implementation milestones.

  • Update and maintain trackers, dashboards and supporting program documentation.

  • Monitor open action items, owners, due dates, status updates and follow-up requirements.

  • Review submitted documentation for completeness and accuracy.

  • Perform data validation and conformance checks to identify inconsistencies, gaps and potential follow-up needs.

  • Analyze QA/QC information to identify trends and patterns beyond surface-level tracking.

  • Compile routine status reports and clear summaries for stakeholders.

  • Coordinate with stakeholders to obtain missing information and clarify incomplete or evolving data.

  • Connect related information across safety programs, field activities, Operating Units and implementation efforts.

  • Maintain organized records and documentation to support audit readiness.

  • Track corrective actions and support follow-through to completion.

  • Support continuous improvement of Safety Management System QA/QC processes.

  • Manage multiple workstreams, priorities, data points and deadlines with accuracy and attention to detail.

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience supporting one or more of the following areas:

    • Safety

    • Quality assurance/quality control

    • Compliance

    • Audit

    • Data analysis

    • Project coordination

    • Operational reporting

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, gaps, inconsistencies and follow-up requirements.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams, owners, deadlines and competing priorities.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to translate data and program information into clear summaries.

  • Comfortable working with incomplete or evolving information and asking appropriate questions to move work forward.

Education

A bachelor's degree in Safety, Quality Management, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, Environmental Health and Safety or a related field is preferred.

Equivalent relevant work experience supporting safety, quality, compliance, audit, analytics or operational programs may be considered in lieu of a degree.

Technical Skills

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including filtering, sorting, conditional formatting, formulas, pivot tables and basic trend analysis.

  • Experience using SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, PowerPoint, Outlook and other Microsoft 365 applications.

  • Experience maintaining trackers, dashboards and structured program records.

  • Familiarity with QA/QC practices including:

    • Conformance checks

    • Data validation

    • Documentation review

    • Corrective action tracking

    • Trend analysis

    • Audit readiness

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting Safety Management Systems.

  • Quality assurance or quality control experience.

  • Audit or compliance program experience.

  • Risk management or operational excellence experience.

  • Experience working across multiple business units, Operating Units or cross-functional teams.

  • Experience coordinating program data and implementation activities across multiple stakeholders.

job.description:
Location: Irvine, CA (Onsite)

Schedule: 4:30am - 1:00pm PST, Monday to Friday

Duration: 12 Month Contract

Pay Rate: $20.95/hr



Position Summary




Our client is a global medical device manufacturer seeking an Associate Sewer to join its production team in Irvine, CA. The role applies skill and dexterity in the sewing of tissue and non-tissue components used to produce medical devices, in keeping with regulatory and company guidelines. Work is performed under a microscope in a cleanroom manufacturing environment.



Essential Functions and Responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced Lead Payroll Specialist to take ownership of payroll operations within a fast-paced, highly regulated aerospace and advanced manufacturing environment.

This is a senior individual-contributor position suited to an experienced payroll professional who can independently manage complex, multi-state payroll activity while acting as the technical subject matter expert for payroll compliance, systems, reconciliations and controls.

Working closely with HR, Finance and external partners, you will be responsible for ensuring payroll is delivered accurately, on time and in accordance with federal, state and local requirements.

What You'll Do

  • Manage end-to-end biweekly, multi-cycle and off-cycle payroll processing across multiple states and entities.

  • Review and validate earnings, deductions, payroll taxes, garnishments, adjustments and other payroll inputs.

  • Manage final-pay requirements and supplemental payments including bonuses, commissions and severance.

  • Maintain the payroll calendar and ensure appropriate processing controls and governance are followed.

  • Ensure ongoing compliance with federal, state and local payroll tax regulations and wage and hour requirements.

  • Lead year-end payroll activities including W-2 preparation, reconciliation and reporting.

  • Monitor regulatory changes and work with HR and other stakeholders to address potential compliance risks.

  • Perform payroll general ledger reconciliations and coordinate payroll funding requirements with Finance.

  • Investigate payroll variances and discrepancies, identifying root causes and implementing appropriate resolutions.

  • Develop and maintain payroll internal controls, procedures and audit documentation.

  • Support internal and external payroll audits and ensure accurate, defensible payroll records.

  • Act as a payroll systems subject matter expert across platforms such as ADP Workforce Now and Workday.

  • Support payroll system enhancements, integrations, testing and vendor coordination.

  • Maintain payroll SOPs, documentation and data governance standards.

  • Identify opportunities to automate and improve payroll processes.

  • Partner with HR to ensure employee changes affecting payroll are processed accurately.

  • Coordinate with Benefits teams regarding deductions, reconciliation and appropriate tax treatment.

  • Collaborate with Finance on payroll accruals, reporting and financial planning.

What We're Looking For

  • 5–7+ years of progressive payroll experience, ideally within a complex multi-state environment.

  • Strong knowledge of federal, state and local payroll tax regulations and payroll compliance requirements.

  • Experience working within manufacturing, aerospace, automotive, life sciences, defense or another highly regulated environment is strongly preferred.

  • Experience supporting payroll within an organization where strong financial controls, auditability and fiduciary scrutiny are essential.

  • Hands-on experience with payroll platforms such as ADP Workforce Now and/or Workday.

  • Strong payroll reconciliation and general ledger experience.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, reconciliations and complex formulas.

  • Experience developing or maintaining payroll controls, SOPs and audit documentation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies independently.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to partner effectively across HR, Finance and other business functions.

FPC or CPP certification is preferred but not required.

The Opportunity

This is an urgent contract-to-hire opportunity with the potential for permanent employment. Candidates interested exclusively in a direct-hire opportunity may also be considered depending on experience.

You'll join a technically sophisticated organization operating in a highly regulated aerospace environment, taking a key role in strengthening payroll operations, compliance and financial controls during a period of continued growth.

Salesforce Financial Services Cloud | Snowflake | ComplyAdvantage | OCS | SQL | Python | REST APIs | Event-Driven Architecture | Cloud | CI/CD | DevSecOps | AI/ML | GenAI | LLMs | RAG | Data Governance | Data Lineage

job.title: Prototype Trim Technician – Automotive Seating
job.description:
Prototype Trim Technician – Automotive Seating

Location: Irvine, CA
Contract: 6 months
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
Work Arrangement: On-site

We are seeking an experienced Prototype Trim Technician to support an automotive Seat Laboratory in Irvine, California.

This is a highly hands-on position focused on the development and assembly of prototype automotive seating. You will be responsible for cutting and sewing seat trim materials, producing finished trim covers and supporting the complete seat build process from individual components through to finished assemblies.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in automotive upholstery, seat trim, industrial sewing or closely related upholstery manufacturing, with the ability to work accurately from patterns, drawings and engineering specifications.

Key Responsibilities

Trim Cutting & Preparation

  • Read and interpret trim patterns, work instructions and digital cutting layouts.

  • Cut leather, fabric, vinyl and other seating materials accurately to specification.

  • Inspect materials for defects and verify grain direction, orientation and color matching.

  • Label and organize cut components to support efficient prototype builds.

  • Operate manual and automated cutting equipment as required.

Industrial Sewing & Trim Assembly

  • Operate industrial sewing equipment including single-needle, double-needle, overlock and walking-foot machines.

  • Sew complex automotive seat trim components to required tolerances.

  • Produce seams, top-stitching and decorative features in accordance with design and quality requirements.

  • Apply foam, scrim, backing and reinforcement materials as required.

  • Inspect stitch quality, seam allowances, alignment and dimensional accuracy throughout the build.

Prototype Seat Build

  • Install completed trim covers onto seat cushions, seat backs, headrests and armrests.

  • Assemble seat frames, foam pads, plastics, hardware and associated components.

  • Use hand and power tools safely during mechanical assembly.

  • Evaluate finished seats for fit, finish and overall craftsmanship.

  • Verify the operation of seat features including adjusters, recliners and headrests.

Quality & Documentation

  • Work in accordance with established quality standards, procedures and inspection requirements.

  • Identify defects and perform rework or corrections where appropriate.

  • Record production results, quality concerns and build information accurately.

  • Escalate material, equipment or process issues when required.

  • Maintain a clean and organized work environment in accordance with 5S and EHS standards.

Prototype Development & Continuous Improvement

  • Support prototype trials, engineering changes and new seat or material development.

  • Provide feedback on patterns, tooling and assembly methods.

  • Work closely with engineering, quality and production teams to resolve fit, finish and build issues.

  • Contribute ideas that improve quality, repeatability and build efficiency.

Required Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in automotive seat trim, upholstery, industrial sewing, furniture upholstery or a closely related manufacturing environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to cut and sew complex upholstery or trim patterns to tight tolerances.

  • Experience building complete automotive seats or comparable upholstered assemblies from component level through to finished product.

  • Strong experience operating industrial sewing machines and associated trim equipment.

  • Ability to read patterns, drawings, specifications and detailed work instructions.

Preferred Technical Skills

Experience with equipment and systems such as:

  • Industrial sewing machines

  • Cutters, skivers, binders and sergers

  • Pattern or nesting software such as Optitex or equivalent

  • Manufacturing HMIs and production terminals

  • Basic manufacturing, quality and reporting systems

What We're Looking For

This position suits someone who takes pride in craftsmanship and can produce prototype-quality work rather than high-volume production alone. You should have excellent attention to stitch quality, seam alignment, appearance and fit, together with the ability to identify and correct issues during the build process.

You will also need to communicate effectively with engineering and production teams as designs evolve and prototype requirements change.

Physical Requirements

The role requires the ability to stand, bend and reach for extended periods and to safely lift and move automotive seating components and materials as required.

We are seeking an Entry-Level Power System Planning Engineer to support renewable energy and transmission projects in Juno Beach, Florida.

This is an excellent opportunity for an Electrical Engineering graduate or early-career engineer looking to develop experience in power systems, transmission planning, renewable energy and grid interconnection.

Working alongside experienced engineers, you will support power system modeling and technical studies for solar, wind, battery energy storage and transmission projects while developing experience with industry-standard analysis tools including PSS/E, PSCAD, PSLF and Aspen.

  • Track the progress of power system studies completed internally and by external consultants.

  • Coordinate required information and data inputs to help studies remain on schedule.

  • Assist with basic power flow, voltage and stability studies under the guidance of senior engineers.

  • Support the development and validation of power system models for solar, wind and battery energy storage projects.

  • Learn and apply power system analysis software including PSS/E, PSCAD, Aspen and PSLF.

  • Support transmission planning and grid interconnection activities.

  • Assist with monitoring interconnection requirements and documenting potential project impacts.

  • Participate in engineering meetings and technical discussions with support from senior team members.

job.title: IAM Engineer
job.description:
IAM Engineer

Denver, CO (Hybrid)

Duration: initial 12-month contract

Pay: $65-70/hr

The IAM Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) services. This role combines hands-on engineering with operational execution, including active participation in Joiner, Mover, Leaver (JML) ticket processing. The engineer will also drive automation, standardization, and continuous improvement across identity lifecycle processes.

This role partners closely with Identity Governance, Security, Infrastructure, and HR teams to ensure identity services are secure, scalable, and audit-compliant, aligned with least privilege and Zero Trust principles.

Key Responsibilities

IAM Engineering & Platform Ownership

  • Design, implement, and support IAM solutions across:
  • Microsoft Entra ID (SSO, MFA, Conditional Access)
  • Active Directory (on-premises and hybrid environments)
  • SailPoint (IdentityIQ / Identity Security Cloud)
  • ServiceNow (access request and fulfillment workflows)
  • Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions
  • Lead or support:
  • Application onboarding into IAM platforms
  • Identity lifecycle design and provisioning standards
  • Integration patterns for new applications (APIs, connectors, etc.)
  • Troubleshoot and resolve:
  • Provisioning and synchronization failures
  • Authentication and access issues
  • Identity-related integration defects

JML Operations & Ticket Management

  • Actively manage IAM ticket queues, including:
  • Access requests and modifications
  • Joiner, mover, and leaver processing
  • Exceptions and escalations
  • Ensure:
  • Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are consistently met
  • Accurate execution and complete audit documentation
  • Proper approvals are captured for all access changes
  • Identify recurring operational issues and:
  • Escalate upstream process gaps (HR, application owners)
  • Recommend and support process improvements
  • Identify automation opportunities within workflows

Automation & Process Improvement

  • Support redesign and automation of JML workflows to reduce manual effort and error rates
  • Eliminate manual steps identified through operational ticket handling
  • Contribute to development of:
  • Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) models
  • Standardized access patterns and birthright access frameworks
  • Partner with HR/People teams to:
  • Improve identity data quality
  • Enable HR-driven lifecycle automation and integrations

Security, Controls & Compliance

  • Ensure IAM processes align with regulatory and audit requirements, including:
  • SOX, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and ISAE standards
  • Enforce:
  • Least privilege access principles
  • Timely deprovisioning and access revocation
  • Strong identity lifecycle controls
  • Support audit requests with accurate and complete evidence

Collaboration & Governance

  • Partner with:
  • Application Owners for access models and onboarding
  • Infrastructure teams for directory and platform dependencies
  • HR/People teams for identity lifecycle triggers
  • Audit and Compliance teams for control design and remediation
  • Reinforce governance model:
  • IAM enables enforcement of access controls
  • Business/application owners remain accountable for access approvals

Required Skills & Experience

Technical

  • Strong IAM engineering experience with:
  • Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD
  • Active Directory (hybrid and on-prem)
  • SailPoint IdentityIQ or Identity Security Cloud
  • ServiceNow IAM workflows and integrations
  • Solid understanding of:
  • SSO protocols (SAML, OpenID Connect)
  • Identity lifecycle management and provisioning models
  • Privileged Access Management (PAM) concepts and controls

Functional

  • Experience in IAM operational environments with ticket-based workflows
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Joiner/Mover/Leaver (JML) lifecycle processes
  • Access request and fulfillment processes
  • Identity governance frameworks (RBAC, ABAC)

Soft Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and execution discipline
  • Ability to balance:
  • Operational workload (ticket queue management)
  • Strategic improvement (automation and standardization)
  • Strong communication skills across technical and business stakeholders

What Success Looks Like

  • IAM ticket queue is stable, controlled, and consistently meeting SLA targets
  • JML processes are standardized, predictable, and increasingly automated
  • Reduced manual IAM effort through automation and process optimization
  • Improved audit outcomes and stronger compliance posture
  • Consistent access control enforcement across enterprise applications

job.description:
Location: Remote (U.S.A)

Schedule: Full-time, standard office hours on East Coast time (EST)

Duration: 12 Month W2 Contract

Pay Rate: $38.00 – $42.00/hr (W2)

Position Summary

Our client, a leading U.S. utility company, is seeking an Engineer – Substation to join its Engineering & Construction Business Unit on a 12-month W2 contract. This is a fully remote position supporting a team based in Juno Beach, FL, working standard East Coast (EST) business hours. The role owns assigned substation projects from conception (Early Stage) through construction and commissioning (Execution), working closely with development, supply chain, transmission, estimating, and external engineers of record. Some travel is required within North America.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • All assigned substation projects from conception (Early Stage) through construction and commissioning (Execution).
  • In the conceptual phase, you will work with the Early-Stage Project Manager to support the engineering requirements and scope with the Development Group.
  • Training, due diligence, and technical oversight of external engineers of record (EOR) for all assigned substation projects to ensure compliance with required generation interconnection agreements, scope of work documents, project specifications, site specific design requirements, IEEE, NESC, ASCE and all other applicable industry codes and standards.
  • Securing engineering consulting resources from a list of approved suppliers by developing a scope of work, securing bids, evaluating, and awarding work through the client's Integrated Supply Chain (ISC) Group.
  • Coordinate with other project stakeholders to develop and secure a substation site, support any engineering updates, data and permits necessary to design and build the substation.
  • Competitively source, select and contract geotechnical, survey, engineering, and construction services, and support the E&C Cost Estimating Team with scope assumptions.
  • Coordination with other groups to ensure that the assigned E&C substation projects are successful. Generally responsible for representing E&C's internal and external interests on assigned projects, including presentations/briefings on current progress, issues, and risk mitigation in meetings with various levels of management.
  • Support Transmission Services during review of interconnection documentation including system impact studies, facility studies, reactive and harmonic studies and Interconnection agreements, and ensure that Transmission Owner requirements and E&C engineering design are consistent and in compliance with all ISO requirements and incorporated into the project design. Must be able to work with and communicate often with the respective transmission owners/operators/ISOs to ensure project deliverables will meet specific off-taker requirements and are timely and accurate.
  • Manage all project long lead major material orders to minimize risk of delays or exceeding the project budget. Assist ISC with all substation project SOW creation, review, approval, and preparation of shopping carts for engineering services and materials in a timely manner.
  • Support E&C Estimating with template updates via project feedback, technical support, and scope modifications.
  • Work collaboratively with project engineering resources in various disciplines to determine project priorities, work plans and lines of demarcation.
  • Ensure projects are efficiently, cost effectively and safely implemented in accordance with department processes, procedures, industry standards and policies.
  • Support assigned project commissioning activities to meet corporate objectives.
  • Support Legal in any regulatory filings, depositions and/or hearings.
  • Collaborate with component OEMs to enhance/adapt their designs to better integrate with the client's philosophies.

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering is preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in substation design and engineering of High Voltage substation projects is highly preferred.
  • Project Engineering and/or Project Management experience, ideally on substation or interconnection projects from the owner or EPC side.
  • PMP and/or P.E. in a related discipline is a plus.

Knowledge/Skills

  • Full-lifecycle project ownership, from early-stage scoping through construction and commissioning.
  • Scope of work development and procurement – writing SOWs, issuing bids, evaluating proposals, and awarding work through a supply chain group.
  • Long-lead material, schedule, and budget management, including scope assumptions and feedback for cost estimating.
  • Risk identification and mitigation, with the ability to surface issues early and brief various levels of management.
  • Vendor and consultant oversight – managing external engineers of record to specifications, codes, and standards.
  • Permitting and site development coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration across development, supply chain, estimating, transmission, legal, OEM, and multi-discipline engineering groups.
  • Clear, frequent communication with transmission owners, operators, and ISOs, plus the negotiation and influencing skills to represent E&C's interests.
  • Strong bias for action – driving decisions and keeping projects moving.
  • High-voltage substation fundamentals and working knowledge of IEEE, NESC, ASCE, and other applicable codes and standards.
  • Interconnection process literacy – reading system impact studies, facility studies, reactive/harmonic studies, and interconnection agreements, and understanding ISO/Transmission Owner requirements.
  • Commissioning and regulatory support, including assisting Legal with filings, depositions, and hearings.
  • Some travel required within North America.
