job.description:
COMPOUND MANAGER

CAMBRIDGE, MA | STANDARD EST HOURS

DURATION:

12-Month Contract

PAY:

$44-49/Hour Maximum Pay Rate




Job Responsibilities: In this role, you will support Medicinal Chemistry and Discovery Research Operations by managing the registration, receipt, storage, distribution, inventory, and quality oversight of chemical compounds supporting discovery research. Key responsibilities include:

· Managing the registration and documentation of newly synthesized and externally sourced chemical compounds.

· Maintaining accurate compound metadata, inventory records, sample history, and electronic documentation.

· Ensuring compound availability, traceability, sample integrity, and accurate inventory control.

· Coordinating domestic and international compound shipments and transfers to internal and external collaborators.

· Partnering with Medicinal Chemistry, Biology, DMPK, Analytical Sciences, Informatics, and external CROs to support research activities.

· Developing and maintaining SOPs, work instructions, and training materials for compound management workflows.

· Investigating inventory, labeling, shipping, and database discrepancies and supporting corrective actions.

· Driving continuous improvement initiatives to improve efficiency, scalability, turnaround time, data integrity, and user experience.

· Serving as an operational point of contact for CROs and vendors supporting compound synthesis, purification, analytical testing, storage, and logistics.

Essential Duties and Job Functions:

· Register newly synthesized and externally sourced compounds in electronic compound databases according to established registration and nomenclature standards.

· Maintain complete and accurate information related to chemical structure, molecular weight, purity, salt form, inventory location, and sample history.

· Conduct routine inventory audits and reconcile physical inventory against electronic records.

· Investigate and resolve discrepancies between physical samples and database records.

· Maintain accurate compound inventory and ensure research materials are available to project teams when needed.

· Coordinate domestic and international shipments and transfers while following applicable regulations and company policies.

· Create, implement, and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and training documentation.

· Investigate deviations involving inventory, labeling, shipping, and database records.

· Drive actions designed to prevent recurring operational issues.

· Lead or contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on workflow efficiency, scalability, turnaround time, and data integrity.

· Manage day-to-day operational relationships with CROs and vendors.

· Partner with project teams, procurement, and quality functions to resolve vendor and collaboration issues.

· Support vendor onboarding, performance discussions, process changes, and business-continuity planning.

· Partner with medicinal chemists to ensure timely registration and processing of newly synthesized compounds.

· Collaborate with Biology, DMPK, Informatics, Analytical Chemistry, and project teams to support study execution and compound logistics.

· Train laboratory personnel and external partners on compound submission requirements, systems, and best practices.

· Serve as a subject-matter expert for compound management systems, processes, and data standards.

Knowledge & Skills:

· Strong knowledge of chemical structures, nomenclature, compound handling, storage, and laboratory safety practices.

· Experience with compound registration platforms, electronic laboratory systems, and inventory management databases.

· Experience with compound registration software such as BIOVIA, Dotmatics, CDD Vault, ChemAxon, or equivalent platforms.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and database or inventory-tracking applications.

· Some experience with Python scripting preferred.

· Familiarity with automated compound storage and retrieval systems preferred.

· Knowledge of high-throughput screening support preferred.

· Exceptional organizational, prioritization, and record-keeping skills.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and sample integrity.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced research environment.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills.

· Ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams, external CROs, and vendors.

· Strong practical problem-solving skills and a continuous-improvement mindset.

Education & Experience:

· Bachelor's degree in Chemistry or a related scientific discipline required.

· Master's degree or equivalent experience preferred.

· At least 3 years of relevant experience in compound management, medicinal chemistry support, pharmaceutical research operations, or a related scientific environment.

· Hands-on experience with compound registration platforms, electronic laboratory systems, and inventory management databases.

· Experience working with external CROs, vendors, or compound logistics networks.

job.title: Senior Data Tester
job.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Data Tester with strong Snowflake, SQL, Apache Airflow and test automation experience to join our data and technology team within a leading financial services organisation.

You’ll play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, completeness, integrity and reliability of critical data across modern cloud data platforms and data pipelines.

Working closely with data engineers, developers, analysts and business stakeholders, you’ll design and execute testing strategies across complex data pipelines, with a strong focus on automated data validation and pipeline quality.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and execute comprehensive data testing and quality assurance strategies across enterprise data platforms.
  • Perform ETL/ELT, data warehouse, data pipeline and integration testing.
  • Write complex SQL to validate data transformations, reconciliations, business rules and data quality.
  • Test data within Snowflake, including tables, views, stored procedures and transformation logic.
  • Validate data ingestion and transformation across source and target systems.
  • Work with Apache Airflow to understand, test and validate data pipeline workflows, DAGs, dependencies and scheduling.
  • Develop automated tests and validation checks that can be integrated into Airflow pipelines and CI/CD processes.
  • Implement automated data quality checks covering areas such as completeness, accuracy, uniqueness, referential integrity and reconciliation.
  • Validate pipeline execution, including successful/failed DAG runs, dependencies, retries, error handling and downstream impacts.
  • Investigate data issues by tracing failures through Airflow workflows, source systems and Snowflake transformations.
  • Identify opportunities to replace manual testing with repeatable and automated test processes.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of automated regression test suites for data pipelines.
  • Integrate automated testing into the broader CI/CD and DevOps lifecycle.
  • Identify, investigate and document defects, working closely with engineering teams through to resolution.
  • Support regression, system integration and end-to-end testing.
  • Review technical and business requirements and translate them into effective test scenarios and automated validation rules.

About You

You’ll be a hands-on data testing professional who understands both data quality and modern data engineering practices. You’ll be comfortable working with large datasets, investigating complex pipeline issues and building automation that improves confidence in data releases.

You’ll ideally have:

  • 8+ years’ experience in data testing, ETL testing, data quality or data engineering QA.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake.
  • Strong Python automation experience.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience querying and validating large datasets.
  • Practical experience with Apache Airflow, including DAGs, task dependencies, scheduling, monitoring and troubleshooting.
  • Experience designing and implementing automated data tests and data quality checks.
  • Strong understanding of data warehouses, data modelling and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Experience testing complex data pipelines and integrations across multiple systems.
  • Experience with Python or another programming language used for test automation.
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how automated tests can be incorporated into the software/data delivery lifecycle.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience within banking, financial services, insurance or another regulated environment is highly desirable.

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating automated tests with Airflow.
  • Exposure to AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  • Understanding of financial data, regulatory reporting or risk data.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

job.title: Civil & Structural Engineer (Power Generation)
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Civil & Structural Engineer to support the development and execution of complex power generation projects, including gas turbine generation, solar PV, and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).

This role will provide technical leadership and oversight across civil, structural, and geotechnical engineering activities throughout the full project lifecycle — from development and engineering through construction and commissioning.

The Civil & Structural Engineer will serve as a key technical representative, coordinating with EPC contractors, engineering consultants, equipment vendors, and internal project teams to ensure designs are technically sound, constructible, code-compliant, and aligned with project cost and schedule objectives.

What You’ll Do

Civil Engineering & Site Development

  • Coordinate and oversee civil engineering activities performed by EPC contractors and engineering consultants.
  • Review site layouts, grading plans, earthwork, roads, drainage systems, and underground utilities.
  • Ensure civil designs meet project requirements and integrate effectively with the overall plant design.
  • Review requirements related to flood protection, stormwater management, erosion control, and site access.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize site layout, grading, and earthwork quantities to reduce cost, schedule, and construction risk.
  • Participate in civil design reviews, value engineering, and constructability assessments.

Structural Engineering

  • Oversee structural engineering activities for power generation and balance-of-plant facilities.
  • Review foundation designs for gas turbines, generators, transformers, and other major equipment.
  • Provide oversight of structural steel, pipe racks, buildings, equipment supports, and structures associated with solar and BESS installations.
  • Review engineering calculations, drawings, and specifications for technical accuracy, constructability, and code compliance.
  • Review geotechnical investigations and ensure recommendations are incorporated appropriately into foundation and structural designs.
  • Coordinate structural interfaces with equipment vendors, including equipment loads, anchor bolts, and embedments.
  • Coordinate structural requirements with mechanical, electrical, and civil engineering disciplines.
  • Ensure designs comply with applicable codes and standards, including ASCE 7, ACI 318, and AISC 360, as well as site-specific wind, seismic, and soil conditions.
  • Participate in structural design reviews, value engineering, and constructability assessments.

EPC & Engineering Consultant Oversight

  • Serve as the primary civil and structural engineering coordination lead with EPC contractors.
  • Define scopes of work, review proposals, and oversee the performance of civil, structural, and geotechnical consultants.
  • Monitor the quality, schedule, and budget of EPC and consultant engineering deliverables.
  • Participate in design reviews, constructability reviews, and technical risk assessments.
  • Support the resolution of civil, structural, and geotechnical issues throughout engineering, procurement, and construction.

Regulatory & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Support communications with regulatory authorities and other project stakeholders regarding civil and structural engineering requirements and approvals.
  • Assist with responses to regulatory comments, technical information requests, and stakeholder inquiries.
  • Support public consultation and disclosure activities when required.

Documentation, Reporting & Risk Management

  • Maintain organized records of technical studies, engineering documentation, calculations, drawings, and project correspondence.
  • Provide regular updates on civil and structural engineering progress, issues, and technical risks.
  • Provide civil and structural input into project schedules, budgets, and risk registers.
  • Support development reports, internal project approvals, financing materials, and technical due diligence.
  • Identify and communicate civil, structural, and geotechnical risks that could impact project cost, schedule, or constructability.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 7–10 years of experience supporting civil and structural engineering for power generation, energy, or large industrial infrastructure projects.
  • Experience overseeing or coordinating EPC contractors and engineering consultants.
  • Working knowledge of civil site development, foundations, structural steel, and power generation facilities.
  • Experience reviewing engineering drawings, calculations, specifications, and technical design packages.
  • Strong technical review, project coordination, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with gas turbine power generation, including simple-cycle or combined-cycle facilities.
  • Experience reviewing civil and structural design packages during EPC execution.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification.
  • Experience with structural analysis and civil design software such as STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, AutoCAD, or Civil 3D.
  • Experience supporting solar PV and/or BESS projects.

Key Competencies

  • Owner/developer-side EPC and consultant oversight
  • Civil, structural, and geotechnical risk management
  • Power generation and industrial infrastructure
  • Integrated site and plant design coordination
  • Engineering design review and quality assurance
  • Construction constructability and technical risk assessment
  • Engineering code and standards compliance
  • Schedule- and cost-conscious decision-making
  • Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management

job.title: Senior Mechanical Project Engineer
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Mechanical Project Engineer to serve as the owner’s technical authority for the design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operation of multi-unit simple-cycle gas turbine power generation facilities, including associated Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and auxiliary systems.

This role will support the company’s power generation development and execution portfolio and may become dedicated to a specific project site during the execution phase.

The Senior Mechanical Project Engineer will provide engineering leadership from late-stage development through procurement, EPC execution, commissioning, and long-term asset operation. The position will ensure project solutions meet requirements for performance, efficiency, reliability, environmental compliance, operability, and lifecycle cost.

This individual will serve as a key technical interface between the company, equipment OEMs, Owner’s Engineers, EPC contractors, and internal stakeholders, providing owner-side oversight and technical direction throughout the project lifecycle.

What You’ll Do

Owner’s Engineering Leadership – Gas Turbine Projects

  • Serve as the company's mechanical engineering subject matter expert and technical lead for gas turbine generation projects.
  • Provide owner-side technical oversight of major equipment and plant systems, including:
    • Gas turbines
    • Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) systems
    • Heat recovery systems, where applicable
    • Fuel gas systems
    • Lubrication and hydraulic systems
    • Inlet air filtration, conditioning, and cooling systems
    • Exhaust systems, silencers, and stack interfaces
    • Cooling water and heat rejection systems
    • Buildings, enclosures, ventilation, and fire protection
    • Black-start generation systems
  • Ensure equipment and plant designs support long-term availability, maintainability, reliability, and lifecycle economics.

Engineering & Design Management

  • Establish and validate design basis, boundary conditions, performance requirements, and equipment specifications.
  • Coordinate technical interfaces between equipment suppliers, EPC contractors, Owner’s Engineers, offtakers, and other stakeholders.
  • Oversee mechanical equipment integration, piping layouts, and balance-of-plant auxiliary systems.
  • Support integration of advanced augmentation technologies and hybrid power configurations.
  • Perform and review feasibility studies, conceptual designs, and engineering analyses, including:
    • Heat and mass balances
    • Thermal performance assessments
    • Water and heat balance calculations
    • Auxiliary and cooling system evaluations
  • Review and validate key engineering deliverables, including equipment datasheets, technical specifications, PFDs, P&IDs, and thermal system documentation.

Project Development & Technology Selection

  • Support project development through technology screening, conceptual design, and performance definition.
  • Evaluate gas turbine technologies and configurations, including simple cycle, combined cycle, CHP, and primary power applications for data centers.
  • Develop owner-level technical requirements, performance guarantees, and specification frameworks for equipment procurement and EPC contracting.
  • Provide technical input into project feasibility, execution strategy, and investment decisions.

Technology Innovation & Optimization

  • Evaluate technologies designed to improve plant efficiency, flexibility, reliability, and emissions performance.
  • Assess turbine power augmentation and inlet air management technologies, including:
    • Mechanical chilling
    • Thermal energy storage
    • Fogging
    • Wet compression
    • Intercooling
    • Absorption chillers
    • Organic Rankine Cycle (ORC)
  • Evaluate advanced auxiliary systems for high-reliability and extreme-climate operating environments.
  • Lead technical evaluations of emissions-control technologies, including SCR and oxidation catalysts.
  • Support decarbonization assessments involving:
    • Hydrogen blending
    • Combined-cycle efficiency improvements
    • Carbon capture readiness and CCUS integration
  • Evaluate impacts of emissions and decarbonization technologies on turbine performance, auxiliary loads, backpressure, permitting, CAPEX, OPEX, and lifecycle economics.

Procurement, Contracting & OEM Management

  • Lead the technical development of RFQs, bid specifications, equipment requirements, and performance guarantees.
  • Conduct technical evaluations of OEM and EPC proposals.
  • Support commercial negotiations and contract development with equipment suppliers and EPC partners.
  • Review vendor deviations, technical exceptions, change orders, warranty provisions, and long-term service agreements.
  • Ensure equipment procurement aligns with project schedule, technical requirements, risk profile, and investment objectives.
  • Develop and maintain strong technical relationships with OEMs, EPC contractors, and major equipment suppliers.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Lead and participate in technical risk assessments, including HAZOP and HAZID studies.
  • Identify and mitigate technical, operational, safety, and reliability risks associated with gas turbine packages and auxiliary systems.
  • Ensure applicable safety, environmental, regulatory, and owner requirements are incorporated throughout design, procurement, construction, and commissioning.
  • Provide technical support for air permitting, emissions modeling, and environmental compliance.

Core Competencies

  • Equipment procurement and specification development

  • Regulatory and air permitting knowledge
  • Strong commercial and contract awareness

  • Strong communication with technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders

job.title: Senior Contracts & Procurement Manager
job.description:
Senior Contracts & Procurement Manager

Hydrogen Group is hiring on behalf of a confidential client operating in the power generation and energy infrastructure sector. This organization develops and delivers large-scale power generation projects supporting data centers and other high-demand energy users.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Contracts & Procurement Manager to lead the sourcing, procurement, and contracting activities associated with major capital projects in an EPC environment.

This individual will oversee the procurement of engineering services, long-lead equipment, materials, and contractor packages from the initial sourcing strategy through contract award and ongoing administration during project execution. The role combines strategic sourcing expertise with hands-on project delivery and requires close coordination across technical, commercial, and project teams.

The successful candidate will help ensure critical equipment and services are secured at competitive commercial terms, meet required quality and compliance standards, and support project schedules and overall delivery objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Sourcing & Competitive Tendering

  • Lead competitive sourcing events for engineering services, equipment, materials, and construction or contractor packages.

  • Manage the full RFQ/RFP process, including preparing solicitation documents, issuing bid packages, coordinating bidder questions, and evaluating submitted proposals.

  • Identify and assess potential suppliers and contractors based on technical capabilities, commercial terms, capacity, and project requirements.

  • Develop bid analyses, comparison tools, and supplier evaluation summaries to support well-documented award decisions.

  • Create and maintain competitive tension among qualified suppliers to achieve favorable pricing and commercial conditions.

  • Conduct supplier and market research to evaluate pricing trends, manufacturing capacity, capabilities, availability, and anticipated lead times.

  • Ensure all sourcing activities are conducted in accordance with procurement policies, quality expectations, and ethical business practices.

Contracts & Commercial Management

  • Lead the development, negotiation, and execution of contracts in partnership with internal legal stakeholders and external suppliers.

  • Ensure agreements clearly define scope, commercial terms, responsibilities, deliverables, and project requirements.

  • Manage purchase orders, service agreements, contract modifications, and amendments throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Coordinate with Project Controls and Legal to maintain visibility into contract status, approvals, and outstanding actions.

  • Maintain complete and organized contract documentation, correspondence, and executed agreements in SharePoint in an audit-ready format.

Procurement Planning & Project Coordination

  • Develop procurement strategies and execution plans that align with project budgets, schedules, milestones, and delivery requirements.

  • Partner with Engineering, Construction, and Project Management teams to establish scopes of work, technical specifications, and supplier requirements.

  • Work closely with Project Controls to develop procurement schedules, sourcing trackers, and equipment or material delivery reporting.

  • Support supply chain planning initiatives that align procurement activities with broader business and project objectives.

  • Maintain visibility across procurement milestones and ensure potential issues are identified early.

Cost, Schedule & Supply Chain Risk Management

  • Monitor market conditions and lead times for critical equipment and materials, particularly items with extended manufacturing or delivery cycles.

  • Identify and communicate procurement-related risks that could affect project schedules.

  • Gather and maintain market intelligence from supplier quotations, market assessments, and other available data to support estimating and lead-time planning.

  • Perform pricing analysis and benchmarking to validate supplier proposals and identify cost-saving opportunities.

  • Develop recommendations to mitigate procurement and supply chain risks and protect project delivery timelines.

  • Track procurement performance, supplier delivery results, realized savings, and other relevant KPIs to support continuous improvement.

Supplier & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a key point of contact between internal project stakeholders and external suppliers and contractors.

  • Coordinate closely with Engineering, Construction, Accounting, Project Controls, and Legal throughout the procurement and contracting process.

  • Manage supplier communications and ensure vendors provide required responses, documentation, and deliverables on schedule.

  • Develop and maintain productive supplier relationships that encourage collaboration, reliability, and innovation.

  • Support supplier onboarding by coordinating required documentation, including tax forms, payment information, confidentiality agreements, and insurance records, with internal Accounting teams.

  • Lead supplier performance discussions and lessons-learned reviews and support improvements based on identified opportunities.

Process Improvement & Strategic Value Creation

  • Support sourcing and contracting approaches designed to improve supply chain flexibility, commercial value, and long-term resilience.

  • Maintain accurate tracking of sourcing activity, procurement pipelines, material deliveries, and key project milestones.

  • Contribute to the implementation and improvement of digital procurement tools and processes that increase efficiency and visibility.

  • Support inclusive and sustainable sourcing practices, including engagement with diverse and community-based suppliers when appropriate.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in procurement, contracts, supply chain, or commercial management within power generation, renewable energy, construction, EPC, oil & gas, or a closely related industry.

  • Demonstrated experience leading competitive sourcing and tendering activities for engineering services, materials, equipment, and contractor packages from scope development through supplier selection and award.

  • Strong knowledge of EPC procurement practices, commercial contracting, supplier management, and contract negotiation.

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

  • Advanced experience using Microsoft Excel and SharePoint.

  • Experience working within an ERP or project management system such as SAP, Oracle, Procore, Sage, or a similar platform.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Project is preferred.

  • Strong communication, analytical, organizational, and project coordination skills.

  • Demonstrated commercial judgment and strategic sourcing capabilities, including the ability to create and manage effective supplier competition.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and support several projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical, financial, legal, and project delivery teams.

  • High attention to detail with a strong commitment to quality, compliance, and accurate documentation.

  • Ability to adapt quickly as project priorities, schedules, and business needs evolve.

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience is preferred but not required:

  • Experience supporting power generation projects serving data centers or other large-load energy users.

  • Familiarity with long-lead power generation equipment and related supply markets, including turbines, generators, transformers, and switchgear.

  • Professional certification in procurement or supply chain management, such as CIPS or CPSM.

Additional Information

This position may provide procurement and contracting support across multiple power generation projects at the same time. Occasional travel to supplier facilities and project sites may be required.

The SAP Security / GRC Consultant will be responsible for performing audit testing, addressing and mitigating audit findings, implementing SAP user access controls, and supporting security and compliance initiatives across SAP systems. This role will also establish development processes, documentation, and templates while supporting alignment of development practices across SAP systems and application teams.

The consultant will assist with the evaluation and implementation of new SAP technologies and solutions, identify and mitigate associated security risks, and coordinate system, platform, and network enhancements in accordance with corporate standards and user access policies.

  • Submit audit findings as assigned and develop appropriate remediation plans.
  • Mitigate and address audit findings and security risks.

Identity & Access Management (IAM) – Intermediate

  • Strong knowledge of SAP Governance, Risk and Compliance (SAP GRC).

job.title: Data Consultant - Data Remediation and Master Data
job.description:
Data Consultant – Data Remediation & Master Data



Day rate contract

Initial 3 Months

Sydney | Hybrid – 2 Days Onsite



The Opportunity

· We’re partnering with a retail organisation on a high-priority data remediation initiative supporting several major digital and operational transformation programs.

· The organisation is investing heavily in AI-enabled forecasting and operational optimisation, but legacy data quality issues across its store technology ecosystem need to be addressed before the broader program can progress.

· We’re looking for a senior, hands-on Data Consultant who can come in, diagnose the current data landscape, identify root causes and establish a prioritised roadmap for remediation.

· This is not purely a technical SQL role. You’ll need to understand master data, retail operations and how data moves across interconnected systems




Responsibilities

· Lead a detailed assessment of data quality issues across legacy retail and operational systems.

· Perform data profiling, mapping and analysis to identify outdated, inconsistent or inaccurate records.

· Conduct root-cause analysis, identifying not just where data issues exist but why they are occurring.

· Produce a detailed diagnosis report and establish a prioritised remediation backlog.

· Trace data end-to-end across multiple upstream and downstream systems.

· Work hands-on within systems, including running test transactions and validating how data is created, transformed and consumed.

· Analyse complex Master Data structures, including product, recipe, inventory and operational data.



Skillset

· Strong experience in data remediation, data quality and Master Data Management.

· Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins and analysis across multiple tables and datasets.

· Experience investigating and resolving data quality issues across interconnected systems.

· Strong understanding of data profiling, mapping, validation and root-cause analysis.

· Experience within retail, FMCG, convenience, fuel or another high-volume multi-site environment.

· Understanding of how product, inventory and operational data flows through a retail technology ecosystem.

· A genuinely hands-on approach – you'll be comfortable getting into systems, interrogating data and tracing issues rather than simply managing the work.

· Strong stakeholder management skills across both technical and business teams.

job.title: Project Manager – Pipeline & Facilities
job.description:
Hydrogen Group is recruiting an experienced Project Manager – Pipeline & Facilities for a 6–12 month contract opportunity in Colorado.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of capital projects across midstream pipeline and facility infrastructure, managing delivery from initial engineering and design through procurement, construction, commissioning and close-out.

Projects vary in scale and complexity, and we're interested in Project Managers who can demonstrate genuine ownership of project scope, budget and schedule.

Candidates can come from natural gas, crude oil or NGL infrastructure – experience across all three is not required.

What you'll be doing

As a Project Manager – Pipeline & Facilities, you'll lead multidisciplinary teams and coordinate engineering, contractors, vendors and operational stakeholders to successfully deliver capital projects.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Manage pipeline and facilities capital projects from development through execution and close-out

  • Take ownership of project scope, budget, schedule and overall delivery

  • Lead engineering, design, procurement and construction activities

  • Coordinate pre-commissioning, commissioning and start-up where required

  • Develop project execution strategies, schedules and cost plans

  • Manage multidisciplinary engineering and project teams

  • Support projects involving compressor stations, pump stations, terminals, process plants and associated pipeline infrastructure

  • Monitor project costs, forecasts and overall financial performance

  • Track schedules and identify potential delays, adverse trends and required recovery actions

  • Develop and maintain project execution plans and reporting

  • Prepare scopes of work and bid packages for contractors and vendors

  • Participate in contractor and supplier evaluation and selection

  • Manage contractors and vendors throughout project execution

  • Administer and manage project contracts, including changes to scope

  • Review project controls information and implement corrective action where necessary

  • Manage project risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies

  • Coordinate construction activities and provide project leadership during execution

  • Ensure project requirements relating to safety, quality and regulatory compliance are achieved

  • Communicate project status, risks and decisions clearly to stakeholders

  • Build effective working relationships across engineering, operations, construction and commercial teams

  • Provide leadership and accountability across internal and external project resources

What we're looking for

  • Strong project management experience within pipeline, midstream, energy or similar industrial infrastructure

  • Proven experience delivering capital projects through engineering, procurement and construction

  • Experience within at least one of the following: natural gas, crude oil or NGL

  • Demonstrated responsibility for project budgets and schedules

  • Experience managing contractors, vendors and external engineering providers

  • Strong contract management capabilities

  • Experience with pipeline and facility infrastructure

  • Exposure to compressor stations, pump stations, terminals, process plants or comparable facilities

  • Strong understanding of engineering, procurement and construction project delivery
